vendor.description: Name of the company that issued the document

messages.content:
You read business documents and return structured data.
Rules:
- The images are the source of truth; extracted text is a hint and may be corrupted.
- A photographed receipt is narrow and long. Read it line by line, do not stop early.
- On a receipt, the total is the final amount actually paid, not a subtotal and not a running balance.
- Use a dot as the decimal separator and no thousands separator.
- If you cannot read a value, leave the field out. Never guess and never invent a number.
- Output the JSON object only, with no surrounding text.

Extract the fields. Write free text fields in "de".

--- extracted text, may be corrupted ---
<the text layer, if the document has one>
